shots.name: cu_palm
shots.js: const g=__G.game; const P=__G.city.palms.filter(p=>!p.street).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-318,a.z-60)-Math.hypot(b.x-318,b.z-60))[0]; g.tp(P.x-6,P.z+6,0); __G.step(4); const c=__G.camera; c.position.set(P.x-5,P.h*0.55,P.z+6); c.lookAt(P.x,P.h*0.92,P.z); c.updateMatrixWorld(); [P.x,P.z,P.h, __G.city.palms.length]
